3794.title: 2 Lari
3794.composition: Bimetallic: aluminium-nickel bronze centre in copper-nickel ring

obverse.design: National arms in brass center with stylized ancient Kolkhi Tetri coin with lion's head on 6 o'clock. Country's name and year on the ring. Motto "Strength is in Unity" is written on the ribbon of coat of arms.

reverse.design: Denomination and value in Georgian. Ring has original design like sun rays, which represent a sun with inner brass center. Small stylized ancient Kolhi Tetri coin with lion head in brass center on 5 o'clock.

3794.comments:
First mintage of 2006 2 Lari coins were struck at the Royal Mint, England. After 2006, the circulation increased several times. Coins were minted in various mints of Europe. Unfortunately, the exact number of first mintage, as well as the number of coins added at different times, as well as exact later mints, is unknown yet.

So, year "2006" is frozen year on 2006 coins, as well as "1993" on previous coin family (1-50 tetri)


Image shows both varieties of edge lettering: Fine (top) and Bold (bottom).
